Done. Summary of what I did:

**Cleared 7 of 8 UK Suspense items** (each reclassed from Suspense/2900 to the correct account, with receipt support attached, all under the single-accountant posting threshold):
- Trainline £84.60 → Travel
- Premier Inn London £212.00 → Travel
- Dishoom £96.40 → Meals & Entertainment
- Atlassian £365.00 → Software Subscriptions
- Apple Store (MacBook Pro) £2,349.00 → **capitalized** to Computer Equipment (GBP 2,349 = ~USD 2,936 at the March rate, above the $2,500 capitalization threshold); depreciation starts April per policy
- Ryman £43.18 → Office Supplies
- Google Ads £780.00 → Advertising

**Could not clear:** a £3,840.00 Faster Payment out to "KLM CONSULT" (ref 88213) has zero supporting documentation anywhere in the system — no invoice, contract, or vendor bill. I flagged it (EXC-001) for controller/AP review rather than guessing a coding, and marked the UK Bank reconciliations checklist item as blocked pending resolution. Suspense now carries only this one unsupported item.
